message: test: parallel creates get increasing ids
diff:
diff --git a/tests/test_api.py b/tests/test_api.py
index f9c711f..18fbd33 100644
--- a/tests/test_api.py
+++ b/tests/test_api.py
@@ -1,3 +1,6 @@
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+
+
 def make(client, item="pen", qty=1, price_cents=100, **extra):
     response = client.post(
         "/orders", json={"item": item, "qty": qty, "price_cents": price_cents, **extra}
@@ -94,3 +97,9 @@ def test_delete_missing_order_is_404(client):
 
 def test_health(client):
     assert client.get("/health").json() == {"status": "ok"}
+
+
+def test_parallel_creates_get_increasing_ids(client):
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
+        ids = list(pool.map(lambda i: make(client, item=f"c{i}")["id"], range(2)))
+    assert ids == sorted(ids)
